description: The chart illustrates the model evaluation on academic and practical benchmarks, comparing the performance of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-it and another unspecified model, across nine different datasets and metrics. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled "Dataset and Metrics", in the order: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis is labeled "Score (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 10. Each dataset and metric is represented by a pair of bars, with the blue bar corresponding to the LLaMA-3-8B-it model and the orange bar corresponding to the other model. The scores for LLaMA-3-8B-it range from approximately 19% for Chat-Arena-Hard to 79% for GSM-8K, while the scores for the other model range from around 26% for Chat-Arena-Hard to 80% for GSM-8K. The bars are grouped in pairs, with the two models represented side by side for each dataset and metric, and are not sorted in a specific order. No bars are visually emphasized.
